revision_summary: One quote timestamp needs correction and two labeling/classification issues need tightening: (1) In script_coverage[10] (bill_collection), the customer quote 'I can take a picture when I get home and send it to you at this number right here that you're calling from?' is correctly attributed but mis-timestamped as 02:13 — it actually occurs at 02:44 (02:13 is the rep's 'we just need one last thing, and I know you're driving' line). Fix the ts field. (2) In cherry_pick_moments, the 'spouse_handling' entry at 01:20 cites protocols.adult_child_decision_maker as its schema_reference but labels itself 'spouse_handling' — rename the classification to 'adult_child_decision_maker' for consistency with the cited schema section, since these are distinct protocols in the schema. (3) The cross_sell_miss classification at 01:51 should be softened to reflect that the rep did offer a correct partial bridge ('we have our own in house roofing') per its own alternative_hypothesis — consider relabeling as a partial/incomplete bridge rather than a full miss, to avoid conflating this with total cross-sell non-responses elsewhere in the corpus. These are targeted fixes; the overall trajectory read, outcome reclassification (no_appointment), and bill-anchor audit are well-grounded and should be preserved as-is.
